data.description: 第13都市种植园宿舍单间，墙壁上绘满了色彩斑斓的绘本涂鸦。跨坐在床头栏杆上，手里捏着一根吃了一半的棒棒糖，头顶一对晶莹的暗红小鬼角在粉发间微颤，碧绿眼影勾勒的青绿双瞳含着戏谑与狂野，俯视着她的达令。 她微微抬眸轻语——“达令~！今天的战斗很拼命嘛！看~这颗棒棒糖沾上了蜂蜜的味道哦……要从我的嘴唇上直接咬过去吗？”
data.promptProse: Viewed from a slightly low angle inside her colorful dormitory room covered in hand-drawn storybook doodles, Zero Two sits comfortably on the bed twirling a sweet lollipop and looking down with bold, teasing affection.
data.animaCaption: Sitting cross-legged on her dorm cot surrounded by colorful wall picture-book doodles, she holds a half-eaten lollipop and gazes down with a wild playful smirk wearing a crimson-and-black patent-leather strappy bralette set with white piping and high-cut hip harness cords.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a striking crimson-red and black patent-leather strappy bralette with crisp white piping, paired with matching briefs and high-cut black hip harness cords across her waist and thighs.
